question: Should OpenClaw standardize `openclaw commands list/inspect` as the v1 inventory, and which JSON and plugin metadata fields must remain stable?
rationale: The proposal creates a new public CLI and plugin-adjacent contract whose permanent naming, overlap, and compatibility boundary require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept minimal commands v1
options.body: Ratify the command-owned surface with schema version, identity, and provenance stable while deferring broader lenses and optional metadata.

options.title: Accept broader catalog contract
options.body: Own cross-registry operational lenses and richer plugin metadata with explicit evolution and upgrade guarantees.

options.title: Defer a core inventory
options.body: Keep current inventories separate until a stronger core consumer and long-term owner justify a stable aggregate contract.

recommendation.title: Accept minimal commands v1
recommendation.body: Ratify the command-owned surface with schema version, identity, and provenance stable while deferring broader lenses and optional metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the RFC lifecycle and are the strongest available person to coordinate the acceptance decision.
